title: JMAP: HTTP Basic Auth middleware using CredentialStore
description: Implement authentication on all JMAP HTTP endpoints. Mechanism: HTTP Basic Auth (Authorization: Basic <base64(user:pass)>). Rationale: RFC 8620 does not mandate a mechanism; Basic over TLS is what JMAP clients (Thunderbird, etc.) support out of the box. Bearer tokens require an issuance endpoint. Add an Axum extractor that: (1) reads Authorization header, (2) decodes base64(user:pass), (3) calls CredentialStore::check(), (4) returns 401 WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm=usenet-ipfs on failure. When auth.required=false and users is empty (is_dev_mode()), pass all requests. Also enforce auth on the blob download endpoint (/jmap/download) and validate account_id matches the authenticated username (fixes 5w3.19 as a side effect).
